blocks.html: Cast-in-place and precast concrete walls shall comply with Section 722.2.1.1. Multi-wythe concrete walls shall comply with Section 722.2.1.2. Joints between precast panels shall comply with Section 722.2.1.3. Concrete walls with gypsum wallboard or plaster finish shall comply with Section 722.2.1.4.
